title: 可倾斜等正方形装入圆
titleEn: Tilted equal squares in a circle

knownBest.source: The-Anh Vu-Le proved in Lean 4 with Mathlib (September 2026) the least radius of a disc holding n = 1–7 unit squares and the optimal packings (repository vltanh/three-unit-squares-in-circle, cited at commit 089a1cb); Erich Friedman's table lists it as proved. For n = 3 the optimal radius is r = 5√17/16, and this problem scores 1/r. The site cites the formal proof and has not re-run its build; a nine-decimal certificate cannot attain this value, and no grid optimum is claimed.

the tilted 2 × 2 block has common side √2/2; optimality proved by the International Math Summer Camp (2026). The-Anh Vu-Le's Lean 4 formalisation (https://github.com/vltanh/three-unit-squares-in-circle, commit 089a1cb) also covers this case.

The-Anh Vu-Le proved in Lean 4 with Mathlib (September 2026) the least radius of a disc holding n = 1–7 unit squares and the optimal packings (repository vltanh/three-unit-squares-in-circle, cited at commit 089a1cb); Erich Friedman's table lists it as proved. For n = 5 the optimal radius is r = √10/2, and this problem scores 1/r. The site cites the formal proof and has not re-run its build; exact comparison uses 1/r² = 2/5, which the site certificate attains.
